episodes.title: Pilot (1)
episodes.summary: Wilkin Brattle, a warrior knight for King Edward I, becomes a farmer, but he can't shake his past in the premiere of this drama set in the Middle Ages.

episodes.title: Pilot (2)
episodes.summary: Wilkin Brattle, a warrior knight for King Edward I, becomes a farmer, but he can't shake his past.

episodes.title: Effigy / Delw
episodes.summary: When an unlikely suspect is charged with treason, Wilkin must carry out his duties as the new executioner.

episodes.title: A Hunger / Newyn
episodes.summary: Lady Love journeys to Windsor to learn the fate of Ventrishire from King Edward II. Back at Castle Ventris, Milus and company welcome a visit from Baron Pryce.

episodes.title: Piss Profit / Proffidwyr Troeth
episodes.summary: The King's right hand visits Ventrishire on official Royal business. Milus enlists Wilkin to go on a covert mission to retrieve a valuable artifact.

episodes.title: Thorns / Drain
episodes.summary: Wilkin and Toran encounter a new timeline for their revenge. Lady Love gets a surprise visit from an unlikely ally. Directed by Billy Gierhart.

episodes.title: Behold the Lamb / Gweled Yr Oen
episodes.summary: Wilkin and Lady Love come to grips with condemning an innocent man to death. Directed by Ashley Way.

episodes.title: Broken Things / Pethau Toredig
episodes.summary: Wilkin, Milus and Toran team up to hunt down a fugitive

episodes.title: The Bernadette Maneuver / Cynllwyn Bernadette
episodes.summary: Ventrishire encounters an old French foe as Wilkin learns new insight into his holy destiny.

episodes.title: Blood and Quiescence / Crau a Chwsg
episodes.summary: Wilkin and Milus lead an unlikely band of brothers on a life-threatening rescue mission
